groups.resolved_scope: Only absence of an observed dependency/infrastructure failure. Not proof of general solver support; selected by observed status, not a population algorithm ranking.
groups.stage_timing_scope: Frontend timers are included when assigned after their calls return. Backend inflation, alternate-path, optimization, validation and recovery counters are included only if the whole backend returned a candidate and final validation without exception, failed stage or incomplete terminal status, with both optimization and validation timers. Normal returned solver failures remain eligible. All counters from an incomplete backend, including completed early work and partial positive values, are excluded from stage statistics; raw timing remains in each observation. Genuine zero recovery on a complete backend is retained. These selected stage means are not unconditional pipeline latencies.

groups.attainment_scope: Final validated output latency observed in this fixed-budget run. Not new runs with shorter optimizer budgets and not the first feasible iterate.
groups.missing_values: Unavailable or incompletely returned backend stages are excluded, never zero-filled; each statistic reports count. Raw initialized zeros remain only as evidence in timing. Cold latency includes legal failures. Invalid input latency is excluded.
groups.convergence_scope: Native convergence is the candidate's explicit solver_converged boolean only; missing values stay unknown and are never inferred from solver_success or successful collision validation. Successful outputs are partitioned into explicitly converged, explicitly nonconverged validated incumbent, and unknown convergence. Unknown counts over all legal jobs include jobs without a candidate; the candidate-only count is also reported. Termination counts use candidate termination, then solver_status, then native_status, without replacing the common evaluated path-length cost.
groups.native_objective: CHOMP trajectory smoothness and canonical-geometry C-space arc-integral potential
groups.evaluation_objective: sum of Euclidean joint-space PWL segment lengths in radians
groups.initialization: same validated native DRM path as LSCS
groups.output_scope: All valid-input attempts form the success and latency denominator; quality conditions on common numerical validation

pairing_scope: All six methods use identical frozen endpoints, geometry, input hashes, wall-clock budget and repetition seed. Roadmap ID is a pairing identifier for OMPL only; those algorithms never load or query that roadmap.
frontend_scope: Only LSCS, CHOMP, STOMP and TrajOpt share a validated DRM seed path. Shared frontend equality checks and DRM-conditional rates exclude RRTConnect and RRT* entirely.
objective_scope: Common reported cost is validated Euclidean PWL path length. Native optimizer objectives differ and remain explicit per observation; CHOMP/STOMP/TrajOpt smoothness and collision penalties are not relabelled as an exact path-length objective.
statistics_scope: Scene-cluster bootstrap; all endpoint and repeated-seed observations in each scene stay together. 2000 PCG64 replicates, seed 45827. Open-control rows share one physical-world cluster and also have a separate stratum.
quality_scope: Paired costs condition on joint numerical-validation success; all legal attempts remain in primary success and cold-latency comparisons. Finite collision samples do not prove continuous collision freedom.
budget_scope: Cold wall time includes interpreter, dependency checks, model setup, planning and final validation. Offline DRM build is a separate cost; independent OMPL has no offline roadmap cost. Missing stage values are not zero-filled.
completeness_scope: Completeness of supplied sealed runs and all six method pairings. The study protocol separately binds the full case/seed matrix.
